data.content_ref: inline:SRC_04 proposes a 'contradiction' with SRC_003's analogy claim about symmetry of the explicit-procedure/implicit-capacity confound between human panels and models. But SRC_003 says nothing about a symmetric confound between humans and models — SRC_003's content is about a deductive limit where causal completeness makes the compliance-vs-genuine-reliability distinction collapse. There is no analogy claim about human-model symmetry in SRC_003 to contradict. The named relation 'contradicts' is therefore vacuous: it is refuted if the model's implicit capacity is modular and independently probeable, but even granting the refutation condition, there was no substantive claim in SRC_003 to contradict in the first place. This is a relation pointing at an endpoint that does not contain what the relation says it contains.
